_comment: Mode devcal_d19_v3w (B-PREREG-D19-TEMP, state PREREG addendum 1): per-question probabilities of D19 (job-fi5xf art-p3gpi, BEST step 2800 export sha 31062f48, the checkpoint the 48.61 screen and the full-DEV shards score) on its own train-side held-out cohort-dev pool, so ONE temperature T is fitted on CPU (jobs.m2_first_cell.devcal_eval fit) before any DEV / JevBench row is scored with it. Why this set: art-p3gpi stores dev cards as aggregates only, and D19 drew the WHOLE bschema-draw-v3b pool (cell.json n_drawn = n_pool = 253,046, drawn_ids a7306015...), so no v3b row is outside its training draw. Rows = the 804 m2-dev-cohort-v2 dev items D19 built (cell.json dev_card_sample n_pool 804, cohort-excluded from training) + the 200-row dev-card sample again on its own (identity: must reproduce card-step0002800 NLL 0.3376 / acc 0.890 within 0.01). The job refuses (exit 10) unless the rebuilt pool's size, dev-card ids + sha and per-source counts equal cell.json and no pool id / record is a training id. Scored through train.evalcard.run_card(keep_units=True) on the checkpoint loaded exactly as fulldev_eval.load_child (cell's native template jrt-rwkv-g1-v3w / g1v2 = the v3w readout of the screen). No Index DEV / proxy600 / JevBench row, no cohort calibration / retention role. Expected: setup 10 + guard 2 + checkpoint 5 + devcal 28 (21.6 load + lineage as job-fi5xf's screen fixed + 804-row card 3.5-4 min (cell.json train cards: 237 s / 208 s) + 200-row card ~1.2 min (68 s)) = 45 min + build 15; devcal cap 50 (1.8x). max_duration 79 (= caps 72 + reserve 7): quoted hold $4.98, worst case $10.79 (cap $15), expected ~$3.0.
